title: Reset your password
keywords: password reset forgot login email link
body: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. Check spam if the email does not arrive.

title: App crashes on login
keywords: app crash login android ios open close freeze
body: Update to the latest app version, clear the app cache, and restart the phone. Android v5.2 has a known login crash fixed in v5.2.1.

title: Shipping delays
keywords: shipping delay late package slow carrier
body: Carriers may add 2-5 business days during peak periods. Tracking updates can lag by 24 hours.

title: Two-factor codes not arriving
keywords: 2fa two factor code sms authentication verification
body: Codes can take up to 2 minutes. Make sure the phone number is correct and try the authenticator app option.

title: Payment declined
keywords: payment declined card failed checkout error
body: Check the card details and billing address. If the payments service is degraded, retry after 30 minutes.

title: Change delivery address
body: The address can be changed while an order is processing. Once shipped, contact the carrier.

title: Cancel an order
body: Orders can be cancelled while they are processing. Shipped orders must be returned after delivery.

title: Refund timelines
keywords: refund time how long money back bank
body: Approved refunds reach the original payment method in 5-7 business days.

title: Track your order
keywords: track tracking where order status package
body: Use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email or the Orders page in the app.

title: App not syncing
keywords: sync data not updating app refresh offline
body: Pull to refresh, check the internet connection, then sign out and back in to force a sync.

title: Promo code not working
body: Promo codes are case sensitive, cannot be combined, and expire on the date shown in the offer.

title: Account locked
keywords: account locked too many attempts blocked login
body: Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts. Use password reset to unlock immediately.

title: Update payment method
body: Go to Settings > Billing to add or replace a card. The old card is kept until the new one is verified.

title: Notifications not working
body: Enable notifications for the app in the phone settings and make sure battery saver is not blocking them.

title: Website login errors
keywords: website login error 500 browser sign in page
body: Clear browser cookies, try a private window, and check the service status page for login incidents.
